PRESENCE, your call: no operator page or booking page anywhere I could find. What is left: phone 207-483-4412 (stored, matches Google), Google 4.9 from 164 reviews, RV Life $$ (avg $35, which lags the 2026 reports), 5 stars. GATE: 2026 camper reports span $45-55. Latest and highest is $55 (9/2026, motorhome, site 11, water, electric, sewer). A motorhome on water and electric paid $48 in 6/2026. No gateway within 40 km: Acadia NP is 42 km, just outside. Not a Good Sam Park (directory gs false; general 8, facility 7, appeal 9). Passes on the cheapest figure, fails on the latest one. Reviews would favour it if you use them as the tiebreaker.

REVIEWS: Google 4.9/164; RV Life 101 reviews, 5 stars stored; Good Sam 8/7/9 (no park designation); Campendium 16 reviews, rating not read. RV Life: 'The showers could use a good clean but were doable'; 'Views of the bay/ocean from about every site'; 'Sites are big and level, and most have a water view'.

HOOKUPS NOT WRITTEN, campers only: RV Life 2026 reports show water, electric and sewer on sites 9 and 11, water and electric on another. Campendium: 'Hook ups water and electric only at the site' (older). Google: 'We had a full hook up'. Stored inclusion_evidence from aggregators says 13 full + 8 W/E. Sewer exists on some sites by these reports; not written, operator silent. Amperage unread.
FIT: 'Camped in a 35" motorhome. ... Site #10' (Campendium, the reviewer's own mark). 'it can handle large rigs'. Good.

WATERFRONT LEAD, bayfront stored, not changed: imagery shows the campground's lower row of rigs south of its own loop, ~35-60 m from the tidal shore, the loop road behind them rather than between. In front: mowed grass and a meadow with paths in the middle, a clump of trees on the SW point and brush along the upper shore. So the middle of the row has an open walk to the water and the two ends are partly screened. Mud flats at low tide on the image. The upper rows sit behind the loop road and would be bayview at best. If the brush reads as a buffer, the value is bayview.
PIN OK: stored 44.58963,-67.78319 is at the entrance on the campground road, ~130 m NE of the rigs; Google 44.58899,-67.78515 is ~170 m west of it among the buildings. Both within tolerance.
